name: Trusting Others
overview: Scripture warns believers to exercise discernment in trusting others, emphasizing caution even toward close friends and guides, as seen in Micah 7:5. Trust misplaced in the wicked or corrupt leads to instability, likened to a troubled fountain in Proverbs 25:26. God's command to avoid idolatry in Leviticus 26:1 and the call to obedience in Deuteronomy 28:1 highlight that ultimate trust belongs to the Lord. Jesus' teachings in Matthew 5:38 and 26:52 further instruct believers to reject retaliation and violence, underscoring reliance on God's justice rather than human strength.
